annotations.title: SEC share buyback and shareholder return analysis

description: SEC share buyback and shareholder return analysis — Share repurchase history for any SEC filer from annual XBRL facts: buybacks, dividends, total returned, free cash flow, % of FCF and net income returned, stock-based comp offset, diluted share count change per year (splits detected and skipped) and annualized share shrink. Verdict AGGRESSIVE REDUCER / STEADY REDUCER / OFFSETTING DILUTION / DILUTING DESPITE BUYBACKS / NO BUYBACKS plus flags (returning more than FCF, buybacks below SBC, pace cut). Params: ticker= or cik=, years=2-10 (default 5). Example: /v1/sec/buybacks?ticker=AAPL Price: $0.005 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: sec_buybacks
